$description: Appearance-invariant base tokens and Material 3 Expressive style overrides.

designMd.overview: Material 3 Expressive (`material-web` v34.0.21 / Compose Material 3 1.5.0) built from the `#6750A4` baseline with tonal surface containers, Expressive Tone 30 `on*Container` roles, state-layer overlays, and M3 duration and easing motion.
designMd.elevation: Tonal surface stepping plus Material Web Level 1–3 shadows and `material.android.elevation` (1dp/3dp/6dp), no backdrop blur, and a line only where a well or a channel states one (`inset`, `channel`): every other finish draws no edge (`border-color: transparent`).
dos: Express interaction states via M3 state-layer ink overlays (`hover: 0.08`, `focus: 0.10`, `pressed: 0.10`, `dragged: 0.16`) with `state.press-scale: 1`.
Use `shape.curve: "circular"` with top-rounded underlined fields and underlined tabs.
Keep tonal and elevated containers edge-free through `border-color: transparent` in the finish, so depth comes from tonal steps and elevation; a well or channel keeps its hairline.
donts: Do not add backdrop blur (`backdropFilter`) or a surface edge (`border-color`) to M3 tonal surfaces.
Do not replace `outline` focus rings (`3px` width, `2px` offset) with halo rings.

radius.$description: Material 3 Expressive corner scale (Compose tokens at `ac364f3c`: 4px CornerExtraSmall control, 12px CornerMedium/CornerLarge container, 28px CornerExtraLarge modal; capsule buttons via `shape.corners.button: "full"`).

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

focus.$description: M3 focus indicator: 3px solid outline offset 2px (_md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss).

offset.$description: 2px outward focus indicator offset per M3.

typography.$description: Material 3 Expressive type weights; sizes follow the shared scale (ADR 0009).

caption.$description: Small captions and segmented counter labels.

detail.$description: Sidebar section labels, counts, and supporting metadata.

body.$description: Standard body copy, list rows, and dialog content.

label.$description: Control labels, form labels, and interactive triggers.

display.$description: Large display numerals and hero headings.

corners.$description: How a control cuts its corners.

button.$description: A button's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

sides.$description: Whether a field draws the sides and top of its edge, or only the line under its text.

bottom.$description: What the line under a field's text is drawn in.
A field's bottom corners: `0` where the line under it is its edge.

line.$description: Whether focus lights the bottom line alone (a field whose edge is that line), or the whole edge inside a ring.

width.$description: How thick the line under a field's text is where focus lights it (`field.focus.line`), or the edge of a field whose focus is a ring.

size.$description: A radio's box, per input: its diameter.

box.$description: A checkbox's box, per input: the side of its square (`choice.size` is a radio's across).

corner.$description: A choice's corner, per input: a quarter of its box where it is a square, half of it where it is a circle.

face.$description: The ground an unchosen box lies on.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade an unchosen box wears, or `none`.

face.$description: The layer a chosen box turns over to, or `none` where it keeps its ground and draws a mark alone.

width.$description: How thick a box's edge is.

colour.$description: What a box's edge is drawn in.

disabled.$description: What a disabled box's edge is drawn in, where it is drawn stronger than an enabled one.

halo.$description: The state layer's diameter round a box, or `none` where the form draws none.

width.$description: An off switch's track, per input: its width.

height.$description: An off switch's track, per input: its height.

width.$description: A small switch's track, per input: its width.

height.$description: A small switch's track, per input: its height.

width.$description: A small switch's knob, per input: its width.

height.$description: A small switch's knob, per input: its height.

off.$description: How thick an off switch's track edge is.

on.$description: How thick an on switch's track edge is.

width.$description: An off switch's knob, per input: its width.

height.$description: An off switch's knob, per input: its height.

width.$description: An on switch's knob, per input: its width.

height.$description: An on switch's knob, per input: its height.

hover.$description: The side a knob grows to under the pointer, where hovering changes nothing.

feedback.$description: What pressing a knob does: `none`, `expand` (it grows) or `stretch` (it widens toward the edge it heads for).

face.$description: What a slider's rail is filled with.
What a slider's knob is filled with.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade a slider's rail wears, or `none`.

colour.$description: What a slider's rail edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws none.

width.$description: How thick a slider's rail edge is; `control` is the theme's `stroke.control`.

face.$description: What a progress bar's groove is filled with.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade a progress bar's groove wears, or `none`.

colour.$description: What a progress bar's groove edge is drawn in, or `none`.

width.$description: How thick a progress bar's groove edge is; `control` is the theme's `stroke.control`.

opacity.$description: How faintly the spinner's groove shows, or `0` where it draws none.

corner.$description: A popup's surface corner (a menu's, a select's list, a calendar's): `container` is the theme's `shape.container`.

face.$description: The ground a tab strip's track lies on, or `none` where the surface behind it shows through.

edge.$description: What a sunk well's edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws no edge and its ground alone marks it.

sm.$description: A small button's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

md.$description: A regular button's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

lg.$description: A large button's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

face.$description: The ground a disabled control turns over to, or `keep` where it keeps its own and fades instead.

ink.$description: What a disabled control's label is drawn in, or `keep`.

edge.$description: What a disabled control's edge is drawn in, or `keep`.

color.$description: Appearance-invariant C-layer color roles shared by light and dark modes.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets (M3 scrim at 32% opacity).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities and press scale.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking; M3 uses the state layer).

overlay.$description: M3 state-layer ink opacities: hover 0.08, focus 0.10, pressed 0.10, dragged 0.16 (StateTokens.kt).

pressed-opacity.$description: Content stays full opacity when pressed (1; the state layer shows press).

rest-opacity.$description: Opacity a passive indicator sits at rest (a scrollbar's thumb), before the pointer is on it.

disabled.$description: M3 disabled controls: 0.38 content opacity, the disabled finish as their face (10% onSurface container) and its foreground as their ink (_md-comp-button-filled.scss).

motion.$description: Interactive timing roles (a duration and an easing): fast, default, slow, and the state fade.

fast.$description: M3 DurationShort3 (150ms) with the standard curve for control state (_md-sys-motion.scss).

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for fast.

default.$description: M3 DurationMedium1 (250ms) with the standard curve for presses and movement.

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for default.

slow.$description: M3 DurationMedium4 (400ms) with the emphasized-decelerate curve for settling and panels.

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for slow.

state.$description: M3 DurationShort2 (100ms) with the standard curve (MotionTokens.DurationShort2, Easing.StandardCubicBezier; ExpressiveMotionTokens.kt).

timing.$description: Timing curve and duration for state.
